AcidGrid.about: A neon 3D grid floor racing toward you under a glowing horizon - half rave, half Tron. Speed follows the tempo; the grid flashes on the beat.

AlienParade.about: Rows of pixel aliens marching side to side and stepping down; a ship fires on the beat and they pop.

ArchPulse.about: Pulses start at the top of every arch (and arched door) and run down both sides on each beat.

AtomOrbit.about: An atom: three tilted orbits with electrons racing round a pulsing nucleus.

Aurora.about: Northern lights: soft curtains of colour ripple and drift across the wall.

AuroraVeil.about: Aurora curtains hang from the night sky and ripple sideways, fine rays shimmering along them. As the music swells the curtains glow brighter and reach further down the wall.

BarberSpin.about: Candy-cane stripes spiral around and up the object (a barber pole), speeding up with the energy.

BassCannon.about: Big bass hits fire the cannon: the whole wall shakes, a shockwave blasts out and debris flies; between hits a charged core throbs.

BeaconSweep.about: A lighthouse-style beam: a bright cone of light rotates around the centre, sweeping across the room, with a soft haze trail behind it. One, two or three beams; it turns once per bar and flares on the beat.

BeatCounter.about: DJ beat counter: four big blocks count 1-2-3-4 through each bar (the downbeat flashes white), with the bar number and BPM pulse.

BigWave.about: One fat glowing wave rolls sideways; the crest jumps on every beat and rises with the energy.

Bioluminescence.about: A dark night sea that glows electric blue wherever the waves break - every beat sends a ripple of glowing plankton across the water.

BlackHole.about: Stars orbit a black hole at different speeds, smeared into glowing accretion trails.

BlackHoleSuck.about: Everything spirals into a black hole - the stars stretch, the accretion ring glows hotter - then on the bar it blasts everything back out.

BlobParty.about: Gooey blobs that play together: they bounce off the walls and each other, sometimes fly off the edge and come back, melt into each other when they touch, drip with gravity, and on big hits one EXPLODES into droplets that

BounceBall.about: A light ball bounces around inside the object. Bulbs light up by how close the ball is, so you can watch it travel through the middle and hit every side. Every kick gives it a kick too.

BounceBalls.about: Balls that bounce exactly on the beat.

BowedStrings.about: 🎻 A string section: glowing vertical strings shimmer as if bowed. Each string follows its own slice of the sound (low strings on one side, high on the other); loud passages make them sway wider and glow brighter.

Breakout.about: A brick-breaker game playing itself - the ball speeds up with the music and bricks burst into sparks.

Breathing.about: Slow deep swells over each bar for the quiet parts; color drifts gently.

CalmEffect.about: Base for the calm pack: a slow loudness envelope (self.sw, 0..1) instead of beat hits.

Campfire.about: Sit by the fire: a real flame simulation (run at double resolution, then smoothed down) - flickering tongues of deep red, orange, yellow and white-hot near the logs, glowing embers, sparks drifting up, and a few stars tw

CathedralRays.about: ⛪ Light pours through a rose window high on the wall: stained-glass rays fan down through dusty air and pool on the floor, motes drifting in the beams. The rays reach further and burn brighter on the crescendo.

Caustics.about: 🐚 Underwater light: a shimmering network of caustic lines ripples across the wall (two interfering networks, brighter where they cross), while slow swells of light sweep across like the sea surface passing overhead.

CenterPulse.about: Light swells out from the middle on the beat and pulls back in.

Centipedes.about: Arcade-style centipedes: segmented crawlers zig-zag across the wall, dropping a row and turning at each edge, stepping in time with the beat. Their bodies shimmer through the palette and leave glowing trails; on hits the

ColorTide.about: 🌊 A colour tide washes up the wall and back out once per phrase. Its front is a soft wavy line with a bright foam lip that ripples with the groove. At high tide the beach underneath quietly takes the tide's colour, so ea

CrowdSurf.about: A crowd silhouette with hands in the air against stage lights - everyone jumps on the drop.

CrystalGem.about: A faceted crystal turning in space; its edges flash white and it spins faster on every beat.

CubeField.about: Wireframe cubes tumbling toward you out of the dark - a new wave launches on each bar.

CurtainFolds.about: 🎭 Satin curtain folds hang from a rod and sway, the bottom swinging most. A soft light slides across them over each phrase, catching the fold crests; each beat sends a gentle gust rippling down the fabric.

DJBooth.about: A DJ behind the decks: headphones on, head nodding to the beat, hands up on the drop, the booth front pumping with the music's EQ, beams behind.

DNA.about: A double helix twisting up the wall; rungs light up on the beat.

DanceRobot.about: A boxy robot doing the robot: stiff arm moves on every beat, antenna blinking, chest lights to the bass.

DancingSprites.about: Two (sometimes three) glowing sprites that dance together: they orbit each other, chase, mirror, spin apart on the beat, fly off the wall and swoop back in. Each leaves a long rainbow-shifting trail in its own colour fam

DawnSwell.about: 🌅 An orchestral sunrise. In the quiet the sun waits below the hills in a deep blue dawn; as the music swells it climbs, the sky warms through rose to gold, and on the crescendo slow rays fan out. Made for film scores.

DiscBattle.about: Glowing identity discs flung across the wall, ricocheting off the edges with ring trails; they get thrown hard on the beat and spark when they clash.

DiscoFloor.about: A classic light-up disco floor: big glowing tiles with dark grout, lighting up in chase, checker, ripple-from-the-middle or random patterns on the beat.

DiscoSphere.about: A 3D globe of light dots rotating in space; the dots flash on the beat like a mirror ball made of stars.

DiscoTiles.about: Classic light-up dance floor: tiles change colour on the beat.

DragonFlight.about: A long serpentine dragon flies through the sky in sweeping S-curves, scales shimmering, breathing fire on the drops.

EQCity.about: A night-time city skyline whose buildings are the equaliser - towers jump with each frequency, windows twinkle.

EarthGlobe.about: The real Earth turning: blue oceans with a sun glint, green and desert continents, polar ice, slow clouds, and a night side where the cities light up and twinkle on the beat. Best on a globe or cylinder, lovely flat too.

Equalizer.about: Bass-driven blob that blooms from the middle with spectrum colored halo.

Explosion.about: Every hit detonates a burst of sparks from the centre with a ring of fire behind it.

Eyeball.about: One giant eyeball: it opens, darts its gaze around the room 'seeing everyone', blinks on the beat with its pupil throbbing to the bass, then does a finale (rainbow spiral iris or a wink) and closes and fades away. Repeat

Fireflies.about: Warm fireflies drifting over a dusky meadow, blinking on their own until the beat syncs them all into flashing together.

FishSchool.about: 🐟 A school of fish glides across the wall in formation, flashing silver as they turn. On accents an unseen predator darts through: the school parts into two streams around it and then flows back together.

FlowEffect.about: Base for the flow pack. self.drive  0..1 smoothed groove level (speed, swell, brightness) self.surge  0..1 soft beat surge: ~80 ms rise, ~0.3 s fall, never a hard cut self.m      0..1 mood: dreamy (talking / breakdown) -

Fountain.about: Fountains of light shoot UP from the floor on the beat, arc over and rain back down.

FractalBloom.about: 🍄 A breathing, morphing fractal flow: layers of noise warp each other (domain warping), the whole field slowly zooming in and out on the bar while colours melt round the hue wheel. Dreamy and pastel in the talking parts,

FrequencyMountains.about: The spectrum scrolls toward you as a 3D mountain range - each new slice of sound becomes a ridge rising out of the floor.

FullWallPulse.about: The whole wall becomes one big pulsing light, color changes every beat or bar.

GameOfLife.about: Conway's Game of Life: cells live and die each beat; newborn cells flash, old ones glow.

Glitch.about: Digital glitch: a pattern that slices, shifts and RGB-splits on the snares and hits, with corrupted blocks and freeze-frames - like a broken video signal.

GlitterBomb.about: Drop move: the whole wall detonates into a blizzard of glitter on every beat - a white-hot flash, then thousands of sparkles that twinkle out in the palette colours.

Glowsticks.about: A crowd of neon glowsticks waving and spinning on the beat, leaving light trails.

GridPulse.about: The Grid: dark blue glowing grid lines with data pulses racing along them; the whole grid throbs on the beat.

Heartbeat.about: Lub-dub double thump on every beat; the whole wall or a heart shape beats.

HexHive.about: Honeycomb: hexagon cells light up on the beat and the glow spreads outward cell by cell.

Hiphotic.about: Psychedelic interference: stacked sine/cosine fields that warp into each other.

HyperStrobe.about: Rave strobe: white/UV bursts locked to 8th or 16th notes (16ths when the track is going hard), in full-wall, halves, random-tile and bar patterns.

Hyperjump.about: The jump to lightspeed: stars stretch into streaks, the wall whites out on the drop, then you burst into a new starfield.

InfiniteZoom.about: A Droste-style endless zoom: nested squares (or circles) keep flying out of the center forever, each one a new colour.

InkBloom.about: Drops of coloured ink bloom in water: they spread, curl and swirl into each other and slowly fade.

InkSwirl.about: 🫧 Coloured ink swirls in water: dye from slowly orbiting sources is carried by a curling, divergence-free flow (RK2 advection on a 2x supersampled grid), mixing and diffusing. In the drop the flow quickens and the hues d

JellyfishSwarm.about: Glowing space jellyfish pulse and drift upward through the dark; each one squeezes and jets forward on the beat, tentacles trailing.

KaleidoInk.about: 🍄 The swirling ink seen through a slowly turning kaleidoscope: six mirrored wedges per curtain, the hues melting round the colour wheel. Very trippy in the drop, a gentle mandala in the talking parts.

Kaleidoscope.about: A real kaleidoscope: flowing coloured noise folded into 3-8 mirrored wedges, spinning and zooming with the music; every beat punches it outward.

LaserBlast.about: Laser show: beams fan out from emitters and sweep with the music, bolts fire across the wall on each hit, and when the track buzzes (gritty mids/highs) the beams jitter and flicker like a buzzing laser rig.

LaserFan.about: Big laser fans sweep out from the bottom corners through haze and scissor across each other on the beat.

LaserScan.about: Laser sheets: razor-thin lines scan up and down the wall through haze, splitting into fans on the drop.

LaserWeb.about: Laser beams bouncing between the edges of the wall, weaving a web that re-aims on every beat.

LaunchPad.about: A DJ launch pad: a grid of glowing pads lighting up in patterns - chases, crosses, checkers - one per beat.

LavaLamp.about: Slow molten blobs that drift, merge and split like a lava lamp; they swell with the bass.

LightCycles.about: Light cycles race across the grid, cutting sharp 90-degree turns on the beat and leaving glowing walls behind them. Hit a wall and you de-rez in a burst of cubes; when the arena fills up it wipes clean and the race start

LineDance.about: Bars and lines that jump, sweep and cross on the beat.

LiquidChrome.about: 🪩 A sheet of liquid chrome ripples and rolls. It reflects a colour sky with a bright horizon line and a gliding studio light, so every wave throws a moving highlight; beats drop a soft ripple ring. In the drop the reflec

LiquidMelt.about: Psychedelic melting liquid: colours ooze, swirl and fold into each other through layers of warped noise; the whole thing breathes in and out with the bar. Made for the LSD Trip.

LiquidTiles.about: Disco tiles that melt: the colours drip down and smear into each other, then snap back to crisp tiles on the bar.

Lissajous.about: A bright pen draws Lissajous figures; the ink fades into long ribbons.

MarqueeChase.about: Classic theater marquee: warm bulbs race around the outside edge; the chase speeds up and the whole frame flashes on the beat. Sometimes switches to rainbow bulbs.

MarqueeFrame.about: Just the chasing marquee border with a dark middle - layered around whatever other effect is playing.

MatrixRain.about: Digital rain: bright heads with long fading code trails; more streams on the beat.

Mercury.about: Liquid metal: chrome blobs that merge and split, with shiny highlights that slide across them and a hint of the palette reflected in the metal.

Moire.about: Two sets of fine rings (or lines) slide over each other and interfere, creating shifting moire ghost patterns; the beat nudges them apart.

MoonlitSnow.about: ❄️ Snow drifts down in three depths (far flakes small and slow, near ones soft and bright) under a haloed moon. The wind picks up and the snow thickens as the music swells.

Mosaic.about: Mondrian-style blocks that split into smaller blocks on every beat, then merge back.

MovingHeads.about: Moving-head lights on a truss: tight beams through haze that fan, cross, sweep and go wild together, changing pattern on the bar like a real lighting desk.

Murmuration.about: 🐦 A murmuration: a boids-style flock of glowing sparkles. Each bird steers toward its group's wandering centre while swirling around it, aligns with its neighbours and keeps its distance (density repulsion), so the whole

NebulaDrift.about: 🌌 Clouds of coloured gas drift and slowly turn in deep space, cut by dark dust lanes, with faint stars behind. The nebula glows brighter and denser as the music swells.

NestedMarquee.about: Casino-sign frames inside frames: each ring of bulbs chases the opposite way to the one around it, in alternating colours; on the bar the rings flash from the outside in.

OceanSwell.about: Layered swells at different depths: the back ones dim and slow, the front one bright, with foam sparkling on the crests. Calm and hypnotic for slow songs.

OceanWaves.about: Rolling ocean swells: layered waves with white foam caps crash in on the bass; moonlit or sunset sky above.

Octopus.about: Hypnotic tentacles spiralling out of the centre (polar pattern), pulsing with the bass.

OilSlick.about: Oil on a puddle: shimmering rainbow interference swirls that slowly drift, and ripple when the bass hits.

OpArtChecker.about: A Bridget-Riley-style checkerboard that bulges and warps like the wall is breathing - pure black and white, pulsing with the bass.

Oscilloscope.about: The actual audio waveform traced across the wall like a glowing green oscilloscope screen with a graticule.

OutlineTrace.about: Bright comets race along every string you drew, each string in its own colour; kicks add a comet.

PaintSplash.about: UV paint splatters onto the wall on the kick and slowly drips down before fading.

ParallaxWaves.about: 🌅 Smooth gradient waves slide across in layers: the far ones high, dim and slow, the near ones low, bright and fast, each crest glowing. The beat swells the front waves; colours shift through the look over each phrase.

ParticleBurst.about: An explosion of hundreds of sparks from the centre with glowing trails; a new burst on every bar.

PianoKeys.about: 🎹 A soft keyboard glows along the bottom. Each note heard lights its key with a beam of light and releases a glowing note that floats up and fades; in quiet passages it walks a gentle melody of its own.

PillarSpin.about: Barber-pole stripes spin around every wrapped pillar (and spiral tree), faster with the energy.

PixelDancer.about: A neon stick-figure dancer on a light-up floor, hitting a new move on every beat.

PixelFireworks.about: Chunky 8-bit fireworks: blocky rockets climb and burst into square sparks, a big volley on the drop.

PlanetRise.about: A giant ringed planet slowly rises over a moon's horizon, banded and glowing, with stars twinkling to the hi-hats.

PongBattle.about: Two paddles rally a ball across the wall; the ball smashes on the beat and the score flashes on each point.

RainOnGlass.about: Looking out a rainy window at night: blurry city lights behind, drops sliding down the glass.

RibbonDancer.about: 🎀 A rhythmic-gymnastics ribbon traces loops and spirals that slowly precess, a long fluttering tail following its exact path. In the expanded (drop) mood its afterglow MELTS: the trail drips and swirls away like an acid

RipplePulse.about: Overlapping ripples, like rain hitting water, each launched on a hit.

RisingPulse.about: Floor-to-ceiling surge on every kick, like a VU meter made of light.

RisingRings.about: Glowing rings climb up the object; every kick launches a new one in the next color.

RoofChase.about: Light pours from every roof peak down to the eaves, a new wave on each beat, in the look's colours.

Scanner.about: Knight Rider / KITT scanner: a glowing bar sweeps back and forth with a fading tail, hitting the edge exactly on the beat. Variants: horizontal, vertical, twin scanners crossing, or a whole stack of rows each with its ow

ScrollText.about: Base: a message scrolls across the middle; letters bounce on the beat and cycle colours.

Searchlights.about: Hollywood-premiere searchlights: beams rise from the bottom corners and sweep back and forth, crossing in the middle; they snap to new angles and flash on the drops.

SeedDrift.about: 🌾 Dandelion seeds / fireflies drift on the breeze in streams, weaving through a gently curling flow field and leaving soft trails. Beats bring a gust; in the drop the wind quickens and the trails melt and swirl.

Sentinel.about: A giant patrol ship drifts across the grid, sweeping the ground with a scanning beam that flares on the bar.

Serpent.about: A fat glowing snake slithers across the wall (and all the way around a wrapped object): its head glows brightest, its body ripples in the look's colors and its tail fades out. It lunges on the beat.

ShapeDance.about: Circles, squares and triangles bouncing around, flashing and swapping on the beat.

ShapeRain.about: Outlined circles, triangles and squares fall from the sky, spin, and bounce off the floor.

ShapeTunnel.about: Squares, diamonds and hexagons fly out of the centre on the beat, rotating as they grow.

Shapes.about: Draws pulsing pictures: circle, diamond, X, heart, star, square on the beat.

Shatter.about: The wall is a glowing picture - then it cracks and shatters, the pieces flying out and tumbling down.

Shockwave.about: THE drop move: a huge wave blasts out on every beat - whoom, whoom, whoom. Variants: the source MOVES (drifts around the wall, so rings ripple from wherever it is), the core BREATHES (swells and relaxes over each bar), a

ShoreWash.about: A beach seen from above: slow waves run up over the sand with a line of foam, then slide back leaving a wet, darker sheen that slowly dries. The louder the music, the further up the beach the water reaches.

SidePulse.about: Pulses push in from the left, the right, or both sides and meet in the middle.

SideRunners.about: Chasers run down the left and right edges, then shoot inward and meet in the middle - bursting into sparks on the beat. Top and bottom edges chase too.

SilkScarves.about: 🧣 Two or three translucent silk scarves undulate across the wall. Each one twists as it waves (thinning where it turns edge-on) and a bright sheen slides along it. Drops make them wave wider, faster and more vivid.

SirenBeacons.about: Rotating warning beacons in the corners - red/blue or acid green - spinning in time with the beat.

SkyClouds.about: Blue sky with fluffy white clouds drifting across; sometimes a sunset-tinted sky.

SkyLanterns.about: Warm paper lanterns drift up into a dusk sky, swaying and flickering softly. Swells release more of them.

SmokeBeams.about: Fog rolling up the wall, lit from the floor by slow coloured beams that sweep and cross; drops light it all up.

SmokePlumes.about: 🌫️ Plumes of smoke rise from the floor, curling as they climb: each sways on its own, and a rising curl field tears the tops into wisps. Lit in the look's colours; the drop sends them up faster and denser.

SmokyHaze.about: 🎷 A smoky jazz club: slow haze curls upward through a few warm spotlights that wander across the stage. The haze glows only where the light catches it; swells open the beams wider and brighter.

SnakeGame.about: The classic snake game playing itself: rainbow snakes hunt glowing food and grow - chunky pixels, one snake per curtain.

Snowfall.about: Soft snow drifting down in parallax layers; turns into a swirling blizzard when the music gets intense. Snow piles up at the bottom.

SolarFlare.about: The churning surface of the sun - bright granules boil, and flares loop off the edge on the beat.

SoloSprite.about: One big, happy sprite having the time of its life: its core cycles through the rainbow (always a bit brighter than its glowing body), its trails drift through their own colours, and it dances randomly with the music - zi

SoundRibbon.about: The music drawn as a glowing ribbon scrolling across the wall - loud parts swell, colours follow bass vs treble.

SpinningCubes.about: Glowing wireframe cubes spinning in 3D - a cube inside a cube - punching bigger on the kick.

SpinningGlobe.about: An Earth that turns all the way around the object: oceans deep blue, land in the look's colors, ice at the poles, little cities that sparkle on the beat.

SpiralClimb.about: Colour bands spiral up every tree and pillar; each kick starts a brighter band at the bottom.

SpiralHypnosis.about: The classic hypnotic spiral: arms rotate endlessly while appearing to sink into the center, speeding up with the music.

Spirograph.about: Rotating spirograph rose that blooms on the beat.

StarBurst.about: A twinkling star at the tree top; every kick bursts a coloured ring out from it over the whole house.

StarRoll.about: Flying through a 3D starfield while the ship slowly rolls - stars streak into lines on the kick.

StarlitSky.about: A deep night sky with a faint milky band and slowly twinkling stars. More stars come out as the music grows; when it swells, a slow shooting star glides across.

StrobeBank.about: A bank of stage blinders: warm cells chase left to right, flip in pairs and slam all-on at the bar.

StrobeSlam.about: Full-wall colour slams on every beat, alternating halves/quarters, white strobe on the bar.

Sunrise.about: Full day cycle across the whole wall: dawn -> the sun climbs up and arcs across the sky -> golden sunset -> dusk -> starry night with the moon crossing -> dawn again. One cycle takes about a minute (faster when the music

SunshineWave.about: A glowing sun with slowly turning rays; warm waves of sunshine roll out on every bar.

Swirl.about: Glowing dots chase each other in swirling curves, leaving silky blurred trails (mirrored).

Tesseract.about: A 4D hypercube turning through the 4th dimension - the inner cube flows out and becomes the outer one.

TetrisDrop.about: Falling blocks stack up in time with the beat; full lines clear with a flash, and big drops wipe the whole board.

Thunderstorm.about: Dark rolling storm clouds and driving rain; lightning forks crack down on the big drums and light the whole sky.

TilePulse.about: Checkerboard / tile grid where alternating tiles flash on and off the beat.

TileSpin.about: Tiles spin around in 3D on the beat to reveal a new colour on the back.

TileWave.about: Tiles flip like dominoes in a wave sweeping across the wall; each flip lands a new colour.

Tornado.about: A twister of glowing debris spinning up into the sky, wandering left and right, wilder as the music builds.

Triangles.about: Nested spinning triangles that zoom on the kick.

TrussSweep.about: Light pours over the truss top from the middle and sweeps down both legs on every drop (and big hits); in between a slow shimmer runs along it.

TunnelRush.about: Flying full speed down a hexagon tunnel; the rings rush past on the beat and the tunnel twists.

TwinWaves.about: Two fat waves, one hanging from the top and one rising from the bottom, in two of the look's colors. They breathe with the music; on a drop they surge and crash together in a flash.

TwistTunnel.about: Square frames rushing toward you, each one twisted a little more - a corkscrew tunnel that tightens on the beat.

Updraft.about: Things rising: glowing streams, embers and light motes float UP the wall with fading trails, swaying side to side; every beat launches a fresh burst from the floor.

VUMeters.about: Classic stereo-rack VU meters: segmented bars with green/yellow/red zones and floating peak-hold caps.

VectorRocks.about: Glowing vector-outline space rocks drifting and spinning; on the kick one cracks into smaller rocks.

Volcano.about: A volcano glowing at night that erupts on the drop - lava bombs arc out and glowing rivers run down.

WarpSpeed.about: Jumping to hyperspace: stars stream out from the centre and stretch into light streaks. Speed follows the energy; every hit punches it faster, build-ups crank it to lightspeed.

Watercolour.about: Watercolour blooms spread across dark paper with soft, wobbly edges and a darker pigment rim. Where they overlap the colours mix; old blooms slowly dry and fade. A swell drops a new, bigger bloom.

Waterfall.about: A waterfall pouring over a ledge into a misty pool - it surges with the music.

WindowBeat.about: Every window and door frame lights up in turn, one per beat; on the bar line they all flash together.

WireTorus.about: A spinning donut made of light dots; the rings ripple outward on the bass.

Wormhole.about: Flying down a twisting wormhole: rings of light rush toward you, the tunnel bends and spins, and the beat kicks the speed.

ZoomSquares.about: Concentric squares flying outward, a new one launched each beat.

fx.name: ChristmasTree
fx.about: A twinkling Christmas tree: ornaments blink in patterns on the beat, a garland of light spirals around it, the star on top pulses, and snow drifts down behind.

fx.name: ChristmasLights
fx.about: Strings of big old-fashioned C9 bulbs draped across the wall in swags; they chase, twinkle and flip patterns on the beat.

fx.name: CandyCane
fx.about: Candy-cane stripes: red and white (with a hint of green) sliding diagonally, glossy highlight, and the stripes jump forward on the beat.

fx.name: SleighRide
fx.about: Santa's sleigh and reindeer fly across a starry night past the moon, trailing magic sparkles; snowy hills below.

fx.name: Snowman
fx.about: A snowman with a top hat and carrot nose bops to the music in the falling snow, scarf flapping.

fx.name: Presents
fx.about: Wrapped presents with ribbons stack up from the floor on the beat; on the bar one pops open in a burst of sparkles.

fx.name: Snowfall
fx.about: Soft snow drifting down in parallax layers; turns into a swirling blizzard when the music gets intense. Snow piles up at the bottom.

fx.name: MerryChristmas
fx.about: 'MERRY CHRISTMAS' scrolls across in candy-coloured letters over falling snow.

fx.name: ChristmasEve
fx.about: 🎬 Christmas, wide-screen: snow on a starry night, a whole village switches on its lights, a giant tree grows and fills with ornaments on the beat, Santa's sleigh and reindeer fly the length of the wall past the moon, pre

fx.name: JackOLanterns
fx.about: Carved jack-o'-lanterns glowing in the dark: candle flicker inside the eyes and grin, flaring on the beat.

fx.name: VampireMouth
fx.about: A giant vampire mouth: dark red lips open and snap shut on the beat, long white fangs glint, and blood drips from the fang tips and pools at the bottom.

fx.name: HauntedHouse
fx.about: A haunted house on a hill: flickering windows, rain, and lightning cracking across the sky on big drums.

fx.name: BatSwarm
fx.about: Bats flap across a full moon in swirling flocks; the swarm surges on the beat.

fx.name: Ghosts
fx.about: Friendly-spooky ghosts drift and bob through the dark, fading in and out; they say BOO (flash) on the bar.

fx.name: WitchFlight
fx.about: A witch on her broomstick swoops across a huge orange moon, cackling sparks trailing behind.

fx.name: SpiderWeb
fx.about: A glowing spider web in the corner; a spider drops down on its thread with the beat and climbs back up.

fx.name: Cauldron
fx.about: A witch's cauldron bubbling green over a fire; bubbles pop on the beat and the brew boils over on drops.

fx.name: HalloweenNight
fx.about: 🎬 Halloween, wide-screen: fog under a rising moon, a graveyard appears, a witch flies across the moon, haunted houses light up window by window, bats pour out, ghosts drift the whole wall, a row of jack-o-lanterns SCREAM

fx.name: FireworkShow
fx.about: A real fireworks show: shells streak up and burst on the beat - peonies, golden willows that drip down, crackling white strobes and rings.

fx.name: WavingFlag
fx.about: The stars and stripes rippling in the breeze; the wave rolls harder with the music.

fx.name: Sparklers
fx.about: Hand-held sparklers writing loops in the dark, throwing crackling golden sparks.

fx.name: StarSpangled
fx.about: Red, white and blue stars tumble down the wall and burst into glitter when they land on the beat.

fx.name: PatrioticWave
fx.about: Bold red, white and blue bands sweep across the wall in a chevron wave, punching forward on every beat.

fx.name: GrandFinale
fx.about: The grand finale: shells launch three and four at a time on every beat and the sky never goes dark.

fx.name: FloatingHearts
fx.about: Hearts of every size float up, swaying and pulsing on every beat, with little sparkles.

fx.name: BigHeart
fx.about: One giant heart fills the wall and beats with the kick drum, glowing brighter on every pulse.

fx.name: CupidArrow
fx.about: Cupid's arrows fly across the wall; when one hits a heart on the beat, it bursts into little pink hearts.

fx.name: HeartRain
fx.about: Little hearts rain down in pinks and reds, piling and twinkling; the shower gets heavier with the music.

fx.name: RoseBloom
fx.about: A red rose slowly unfurls its petals on a green stem, swaying, then blooms again.

fx.name: BeMine
fx.about: 'BE MINE' with hearts scrolls across over a soft pink glow.

fx.name: Countdown
fx.about: New Year's countdown: giant numbers tick 10 to 1 on the beats, then HAPPY NEW YEAR explodes with confetti.
